title: South Pool Canopy Installation
summary: Work on the pool canopy installation at the South…
public_detail: Work on the pool canopy installation at the South Pool is scheduled to begin tomorrow, July 7, 2026, at 7:00 am. Residents should expect some noise and dust during construction . A portion of the pool area will be closed and inaccessible for approximately two weeks to allow the concrete footers to cure and the installation work to be completed . We appreciate your patience and understanding during this improvement project. Sincerely, Resource Property Management, Inc. on behalf of Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc (727) 581-2662 | www.resourcepropertymgmt.com
